scientific_choices.rationale: Transfer the two observed TRAIN-holdout detection recipes unchanged to all official TEST images. Original RGB bbox IoU>=0.50 is a local diagnostic, not official polygon DetEval.
User explicitly requested TN=0; true negative regions are not measured. Accuracy is TP/(TP+FP+FN).
Exclude predicted instances only when their entire native support is invalid; keep partially ignored boxes complete. Ground truth is used only after predictions are frozen.

FP32 batch1, TF32 disabled, sequential loading/unloading of the three source networks; explicit CPU or single-GPU device. Batch size, CPU versus CUDA, and disabling historical cuDNN TF32 can change borderline probabilities; CPU and GPU equivalence is not established. Record allocator peaks and propagate OOM without substituting outputs.
